title: Show facets with no results
body:
Is is possible to show facet with zero results with instantsearch.js?
Like this: http://take.ms/y5dpr
It seems like a useful feature if you have just a few categories, and you want to highlight those categories to your users.

comments.body:
Hi @ahennie, thanks for your question! :)

It's not possible with dynamic facets (computed from the result set by the Algolia engine). However if you've extracted the facets on your side, it should be possible to create a custom widget for that. This widget could have the knowledge of all the facets that are in the dataset, and if the engine doesn't return a value, it will set the count to 0. The only drawback is that any new value for the facet mean an update in the frontend.

Would that fit your need?

Thanks,

Would it be possible to integrate the widget with instantsearch or do we
have to roll our complete own UI?
Do you know about any other projects who have do it, that could share their
experience?

instantsearch.js is extensible by design. We have some documentation on how to create new widgets [in the documentation](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#custom-widgets). Let me know if you find that useful enough :)
Hello! Is it still something I have to implement myself or do you provide a tool to do it ?

https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-facets-with-count-of-0-forked-q592i?file=/src/app.js is a possible solution for this problem @HamzaInPerth, basically you keep track of every facet name that has been seen, and fill up the list of returned facets in transformItems with extra "empty" facets
